Names proposed from each unnamed class's structural neighbourhood in the meta (referencing fields, member types, base/child stems, sibling families), not from wordlist recombination. 417k proposals against ~7300 unresolved states = 0.71 expected chance hits for the 254 that landed; the same generator reproduced 2080 already-known names at their exact spelling. Each name here is additionally attested by a member or referencing field type carrying its own words, or independently confirmed by a second method. Casing is not decided by the hash - FNV lowercases - so every word was checked against its spelling elsewhere in the corpus with this batch excluded, and against the declaring class's own siblings. Nine names were recased on that check; every name in the batch resolves a field the meta declares.

The 67 unnamed children of ViewController, named against 159 named siblings that fix the pattern <Feature>ViewController. Feature words were drawn from each class's own field names and member types, not from the global wordlist. 1.18M proposals against ~7100 unresolved states = 1.96 expected chance hits; 11 landed and exactly 2 fell outside the family, which is the predicted noise and is rejected here. Each name kept is a class whose base really is ViewController and whose own members carry the feature word: .TeamEditorData for TFTTeamEditorViewController, .Day/.Night on the Monarch-lifespan class for MonarchDayNightViewController, and children MinimapViewController for MinimapViewControllerBase.
